description:
Spec (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00) added BroadcastMention after the initial crate build. This epic covers the full implementation across types, server, and client crates.

Spec surface:
- BroadcastMention struct: {scope, offset, length} (§4.4.1)
- scope is one of 'everyone', 'here', 'admins'; reject unrecognized with invalidArguments
- offset+length must not exceed body byte length
- Message.broadcastMentions: BroadcastMention[], empty by default
- When bodyType is 'application/jmap-chat-rich', broadcastMentions MUST be empty (broadcast info is inline 'broadcast' spans)
- mention_broadcast permission: Message/set create/update with broadcast mentions requires this permission; reject with forbidden
- hasMention filter: must resolve broadcast mentions whose recipient set includes the owner
- Push: broadcast mentions bypass Chat.muted / Chat.muteUntil
- Federation: Peer/deliver carries broadcast mentions
- §4.16 server-side validation: reject unknown scope, reject offset+length > body byte length, enforce mention_broadcast permission

mention_broadcast already exists in vocabulary.rs. ChannelPermission already wired.
title: Add BroadcastMention type and Message.broadcastMentions field
